display_long_description:
Liminal Pool shooter

The resort never closed. It just kept growing.

In a parallel night where the bubble era never ended, an endless hotel pool multiplies in the dark — white tile, black water, fluorescent lights running to a vanishing point. Glowing cocktails drift on the surface: the spirits of a party nobody remembers ending. Lay them to rest.

You glide forward with a wand in each hand. Shoot the floating drinks IN TIME WITH THE MUSIC — every hit shatters like glass and rings out a note. Each color you clear stays behind as a small pool of light, drifting away into the dark.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Shoot the glowing cocktails floating on the water.
- Shoot ON THE BEAT for critical hits and big combos.
- Shoot one color and every cocktail of that color on screen chains and pops — pick the color that pays.
- Every color scores differently. Watch for a dark one that barely glows — it is worth a fortune.
- Shoot the red radio when it appears: it sings a phantom city pop song.
- Three chapters, three songs, a boss spirit at the end of each. Built to be replayed for score.

MADE FOR VR
Your two Meta Quest controllers become the twin wands. You move forward automatically at a smooth, constant speed with no artificial camera turns — play seated or standing. No jump scares, ever.

Liminal Pool shooter — Shoot the party. Let the colors drift away.
